You may find the information you need in the FAQs about the MXR DISTORTION+ M104 listed below. Why isn't my MXR Distortion+ M104 producing any sound? Ensure that the footswitch is engaged, indicated by the red LED light. Check if both the INPUT and OUTPUT jacks are properly connected and that the cables are functioning. Also, verify that the 9-volt battery or power supply is correctly installed and still has power. 0 How can I reduce the noise level when using the MXR Distortion+ M104? To decrease noise, try lowering the DISTORTION knob to reduce the gain, as higher gain settings can increase noise. Ensure all cables and connections are secure and free from interference. 0 What should I do if the MXR Distortion+ M104 effect is too quiet? Rotate the OUTPUT knob clockwise to increase the overall volume. Make sure all cables are connected properly, and confirm that the power source is sufficient. 0 What type of power supply should I use with the MXR Distortion+ M104? You can power the MXR Distortion+ with a single 9-volt battery, a 9-volt AC adapter like the Dunlop ECB003/ECB003E, or a DC Brick power supply. 0 How do I adjust the amount of distortion on the MXR Distortion+ M104? Use the DISTORTION knob to control the amount of distortion. Turning it clockwise will increase saturation, while turning it counterclockwise will decrease it. 0 Is the manual of the MXR DISTORTION+ M104 available in English?
